_about: freeze.json for the Dollar-watch pre-registration, SPEC v1 (forward-only), FROZEN 2026-11-03 after both v1 reviews (stats and data: PASS_WITH_FIXES, fixes applied). Casey's answers of 2026-11-02 ('go with the defaults, freeze it'). Nothing in here may change afterwards except by a new SPEC version, labelled post-hoc.
_freeze_date: D-3 evidence comes only from rows whose data date is after this date AND which fired on the first vintage carrying that date (d3_eligible; data review v1 S1).
_route: Q1 (P1) answered: forward_only. D-1 (cross-section) and D-2 (DXY daily 1973-2005) are withdrawn and not run (SPEC v1 Appendix A).
_primary_crisis_list: Q2 (P1) answered: C16 primary; A25 and V1_strict15 robustness; L-narrow (5) reported, never inferred on.
_decel_primary_variant: Q3 (P1) answered: unpatched decides D-3; re-arm logged alongside, descriptive.
_forward_onset_rule: Q5 (P1) answered: SPEC v1 §5.1-5.3. Pre-committed degeneracy check (§5.4) run 2026-11-02: 8 onsets in 2000-01..2026-10, inside [3,13] -> frozen unchanged.

onset_check.recount_fed_list_2026_11_03: unchanged with the list's two 2026-11-03 additions (8 onsets, 31 months with 2+ markers): spec/v1_work/onset_recount_fed_list_2026-11-03.json

onset_evaluation: each month from onset_first_month is evaluated once, in order, at the first build on or after max(the day after the H.10 release carrying its last business day, its end + 5 business days), once the Fed list is reviewed through it and every input is fetched fresh and reaches its last business day (SWPT: its last Wednesday), or at the deadline (the end of the following month) recording what was missing; one row per month; the subtype the same way at m+2; later revisions only in revision_checks; a row dated after its deadline is flagged late (data review v1 S2, re-check S-1)
_fed_emergency_actions: list v1.1 (2026-11-03): 50 actions, two 13(3) additions after the check (2008-10-08, 2009-03-02; data review v1 M1), the reverse-swap-line ruling, a register of 14 rejected candidates, reviewed_through 2026-10
_lamp_license: Q6 (P2) answered: a colour state and a lamp on layer 3(a) only from a D-3 PASS (SPEC v1 §3.5).

rule_params.index: DTWEXBGS daily on days with DTWEXBGS and DGS10 both published

calendar.in_sample_record: DTWEXBGS & DGS10 & VIXCLS (the frozen script's): the two differ on 7 Good Fridays in 2006-2026 and give identical firings, both variants (stats review v1 S3)
calendar.cooling_under_revisions: last_fire is the last firing of the rule evaluated on the same vintage

succession.DTWEXBGS: the Fed's designated successor nominal broad dollar index, ratio-spliced at the last common date; units admitted before the change are scored on the spliced series; the null is not re-fitted
succession.DGS10: the successor 10-year constant-maturity Treasury yield (Fed H.15 or Treasury), used as is from the last common date
succession.fred_dropped: a series FRED stops carrying but its source still publishes is read from the source: the same series, not a succession
succession.no_successor: the D-3 ledger ends and the last completed look stands
succession.onset_markers: a marker whose series ends with no successor is recorded unavailable; the onset rule continues as 2 of the markers still available, and each month row records which were available

d3.units: a unit starts at a d3_eligible unpatched firing; later eligible unpatched firings with k - k1 < 250 (from the unit's FIRST firing, never chained) belong to it; scored on its first firing only
d3.hit: max B over (k1, k1+250] <= 1.03*B[k1], maturity vintage, data-date anchor
d3.null: GARCH(1,1)-t on 100*dlog DTWEXBGS over the rule calendar 2006-01-03..2026-10-30 (freeze vintage); p_u by Monte Carlo, N = 100000 paths of 250 steps from h_{k1+1} filtered on the firing vintage, seed = YYYYMMDD(k1), common random numbers across drifts
d3._drift: stats review v1 S1: the null cannot know the drift; a PASS is judged at a pessimistic -1%/yr, a FAIL at an optimistic +1%/yr, anything between is INCONCLUSIVE
d3.critical_values: exact alpha-spending recursion on the recorded p_u at -1%/yr, units in maturity order, earlier critical values as recorded, futility non-binding (stats review v1 minor 2)
d3.fail_rule: delta_U < 0.10, delta_U = the one-sided 98.3% (level 0.05/3) upper bound on the edge with p_u at +1%/yr, on the 0.001 grid over [-1, 1] (stats review v1 minor 3)
d3.placebo: the same rule without the deceleration clause (unpatched, the same cooling), logged forward with identical eligibility, units, p_u and hits; its n, S, T at zero drift, tail probability at -1%/yr and whether it matches or beats the rule are printed beside any result and never change the wording (stats re-check S2)
d3.statistic: exact Poisson-binomial on matured units; T = (S - sum p_u)/n reported at each drift
d3.pass_wording: dollar scramble peaking: beat a no-information model (deceleration-specific: not tested)
d3._pass_wording: deceleration-specific wording needs its own pre-registered matched-scramble test, with G6 showing a false-'deceleration' rate <= 0.05, added as a new SPEC version before the first unit is scored
d3.volatility_regime: not bracketed: under the fit window's latest decade (2016-26 volatility) plus a -1%/yr drift a false PASS runs about 0.055-0.079 (G6 and the statistics re-check); the stronger option (PASS on the larger p- of two frozen fits) is Q19's alternative

_d3: Q17 (P2, asked 2026-11-02) and Q19 (P1, asked 2026-11-03: the drift bracket trades power for robustness): the SPEC v1 defaults CARRIED, NOT answers. Any change is post-hoc and needs a new SPEC version.
_onset_exclusion: Q18 (P2, NEW, asked 2026-11-02): frozen as written; re-dates long crises at month 13 (2009-01, 2002-07). Any change is post-hoc and needs a new SPEC version.
_s1: Q13 was a D-1/D-2 question (not applicable); D-3 uses the same 250 / 3% hit, fixed by SPEC v1 §3.2.
